inputs.name: Installed NOR FIT
inputs.revision: Mosaico boot-display FIT used with the R3 root

scenario: After an ordinary POWER boot of the R3 system, run the weather-lvgl program from /tmp on the installed NetBSD #6 system.
expected: The 480 x 480 screen shows MOSAICO, 21 C and SUNNY on a dark background.
observed: The operator confirmed that the screen showed MOSAICO, 21 C and SUNNY on a dark background. The tested stripped RV32 executable was 992,984 bytes and used LVGL 9.6.0.
limits: One reported V1.2 sample and one displayed scene are covered.
The temperature and weather labels are fixed sample content; no sensor reading or online weather source was tested.
This observation does not establish touch input, graphics stability over time or other board revisions.
